image_prompt: A photorealistic 1:1 square overhead shot of a cozy modern Indian kitchen countertop in warm natural morning light streaming through a rain-streaked window. A brass cup filled with steaming golden turmeric milk sits at center on a carved wooden coaster, surrounded by beautifully arranged raw ingredients: a small brass bowl of vibrant yellow Lakadong turmeric powder, whole black peppercorns scattered artfully, a chunk of organic jaggery on a terracotta plate, and a small glass jar of ashwagandha powder. Fresh green tulsi leaves and a cinnamon stick accent the scene. Background shows subtle monsoon rain on the window glass with soft bokeh green foliage outside. Warm amber and earthy tones, styled with a handwoven cotton napkin and a traditional Indian brass spoon. No text overlays, no logos, no watermarks.
video_prompt: A cinematic 9:16 vertical video, 8 seconds, shot in a warmly lit modern Indian kitchen during monsoon evening. Opens with a smooth dolly-in through a rain-dappled window showing lush green outside, camera glides to a marble countertop where a hand gracefully spoons bright golden turmeric powder into a brass saucepan of simmering milk — steam rises beautifully. Camera follows a slow overhead arc as black pepper is cracked fresh, jaggery crumbles dissolve into the milk, and a pinch of ashwagandha is added. Final 2 seconds: a satisfying slow-motion pour of the rich golden haldi doodh into a traditional kulhar cup, steam curling upward, warm ambient lighting with soft rain sounds in background. Vibrant saturated colors, shallow depth of field, smooth continuous camera movement, cozy monsoon atmosphere.
